How the numbers are made

  • Balls faced exclude wides. Legal balls bowled exclude wides and no-balls.
  • Bowler runs conceded = batsman runs + 1 per wide + 1 per no-ball. Leg-byes and byes are not charged to the bowler.
  • The extras columns in the raw file are type codes, not run counts, so team totals cannot be rebuilt from them.
  • Dismissed player is counted out. Run outs can be the non-striker. Bowlers are credited the wicket for every dismissal except Run Out, Retire Out and Obstructing the field.
  • Pressure = death overs (16 to 20) plus super overs (innings 3 and 4). Chase pressure is the second-innings death-overs subset, shown separately in each profile.
  • Matches played come from the playing XI file. Innings = match-innings in which the player batted or bowled.
  • 16 of 883 matches have no ball-by-ball rows, so the analysis covers 867 matches and 200,999 deliveries.
  • Phases: powerplay is overs 1 to 6, middle is overs 7 to 15, death is overs 16 to 20.
Dataset: IPL and T20I, 22 Jan 2022 to 1 Nov 2026. 867 matches with ball-by-ball data, 200,999 deliveries, 141 competitions, 958 players with stats (888 batters, 647 bowlers). Total runs off the bat: 269,550. Bowler-credited wickets: 10,272. Total dismissals: 10,878. All numbers on this page are computed directly from the ball-by-ball file. Nothing is estimated.
